known.label: The staircase he kept discovering
known.explanation: The Borg stands on an up staircase it already tracks - it was seen on the map earlier. The "already known" scan used continue where the down-stair scan uses break, so the match never stopped the scan and the staircase was appended again: the original grows the tracking array from 1 to 2 (a duplicate per visit, until the array fills and later staircases cannot be tracked). The correction breaks on the match: still 1.
